title: A harness selector reproduces change 0649's 77x: the marker-bearing PPTX edit is 77.21x the generated corpus and 20.23x a byte-identical marker-stripped control
decision: retained, harness and corpus work in tools/perf-baseline
code_state: tools/perf-baseline only; no file under crates/ modified; no new unsafe and no new dependency; the harness library keeps #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
reason_codes: change 0649 recorded that every prior PPTX record measured on corpora whose members never mention the markup-compatibility namespace, so the codec branch that costs 93.9% of a real deck's edit had no harness selector; four new corpora and 24 selectors put it on one

the marker corpus ships with a marker-stripped control whose member names, per-member uncompressed lengths, start-tag counts, attribute counts and projected text are proved identical before any sample runs, so the pair measures the codec branch and not two differently shaped packages
the shape is derived from three real tracked fixtures by a retained script whose verify mode is run as a gate, so the corpora cannot silently drift from the files they claim to imitate

change 0649's second gap is closed in the same batch: all forty ordinary-save selectors now open an allocation region bounded to exactly the interval each phase reports, where change 0638 registered twenty-four that opened none
change 0643's gap is closed: docx_semantic_text_to_sink and docx_source_text_to_sink cover the DOCX write_text_to path on both facades
the measured product decomposes the way change 0649's does, 3.82 x 20.23 = 77.3 against 5.57 x 13.9 = 77, and the allocator's 20.93x byte ratio agrees with the clock's 20.23x to 3.4%

accepted_evidence.corpus_census: every member of all four generated corpora and all three derivation fixtures, censused per part for the namespace, mc:Ignorable, mc:AlternateContent count, root declaration count, start-tag count and attribute count; written by --marker-evidence and by the derivation script
accepted_evidence.determinism: two independent builds of each corpus produce the same archive SHA-256, asserted in the module's tests and re-derived by every run that writes a census
accepted_evidence.control_proof: prove_control_is_byte_comparable runs before any sample: identical member names, per-member uncompressed lengths, start-tag counts, attribute counts and projected text, zero namespace mentions in the control and at least one in the marker variant
accepted_evidence.timing: 20 warm-ups and 50 retained samples per run, three repeats of every group plus a dedicated A/A pair for the two heaviest groups, taskset -c 19, binaries staged outside every Cargo target directory and hashed; 5,800 retained timing samples
accepted_evidence.allocations: litchi-perf-baseline-alloc, 5 warm-ups and 20 retained samples over 24 ordinary-save selectors; every work counter identical across all 20 samples of every selector; 480 retained allocator samples
accepted_evidence.oracles: every corpus's eager full text, source-backed full text, object count and sink projection are read back out of the built package before any sample runs, and every retained sample must reproduce them
accepted_evidence.gates: cargo fmt/clippy (with and without allocator-metrics)/doc/test in tools/perf-baseline, non_iwork_gate.py harness-tests and verify, validate_crud_coverage_index.py, four Python test modules, and the derivation script's verify mode

accepted_costs.publication_floors: the four save-to-path and serialize-to-sink rows run at A/A floors of 13.13% to 240.56% because the interval contains two fsyncs on a device eight agents share; they are reported and not relied on, and their counts are the evidence instead
accepted_costs.single_repeat_outliers: two selectors have one outlier repeat each (the control edit at 1.87x on A1, the generated edit at 2.6x on R3); the medians exclude them, the within-run distributions are tight, and both series are published in full
accepted_costs.corpus_is_not_the_fixture: the PPTX corpus reproduces the fixture's slide byte total to 92.0% and its root declaration count exactly, but not its layout and master bytes, because this harness's writer emits eleven small layouts and one master; the capture reads neither, which is why that term was the one dropped
accepted_costs.registry_growth: Case grows from 501 to 527 variants and ordinary_save::Origin from two to four; both are harness-internal and covered by the harness's own registry tests
accepted_costs.packet_size: 24 harness reports are retained verbatim because the record quotes them; the packet is about 4 MB

known_gaps.no_native_profile: no cycles, instructions or per-symbol profile were taken; change 0649 has them for the real deck and this record's job was to make the scenario selectable
known_gaps.no_xlsx_marker_origin: change 0601's XLSX producer family already covers marker-bearing spreadsheets, so build_corpus refuses an XLSX marker corpus with a typed error rather than building one
known_gaps.docx_sink_refusal_scope: the marker DOCX is refused by the eager sink parser's cumulative namespace-binding limit while its byte-identical control is admitted; this is a corpus fact, and no survey of real Word files was run, so nothing is claimed about them
known_gaps.no_marker_text_sink_selector: that refusal is why there is none; the refusal string is frozen in the corpus census instead
known_gaps.single_shape_per_family: one PPTX shape and one DOCX shape; no size sweep was taken, and the 130-text-box variant that matches the fixture's package total was measured once and rejected rather than retained
known_gaps.no_cold_cache_or_rss: every run is warm, and no RSS measurement was taken

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, cold-cache, physical-I/O, concurrency-scaling or cross-platform result
any claim that real Word files are refused by the DOCX sink parser
any latency conclusion from the four publication rows
